subject: Request: temporary remit moratorium + tax entity routing (BioVerge)
messages:
From: Elaine Turner <elaine.turner@bioverge.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: accounts@bioverge.com
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary remit moratorium + tax entity routing

Marcus —

Thanks for taking this. BioVerge is in the final week of closing on a small acquisition and our treasury has asked for a short moratorium on outbound vendor payments while bank signatories are updated. Specifically, we are requesting: 

- A 30-day temporary remit moratorium on invoices dated Oct 1–Oct 31 (we still need services to continue).
- During the moratorium we propose milestone-based partial payments: 40% on delivery, 40% at acceptance, 20% on final invoice.
- Because the acquired entity is UK-based and will be billed under a different VAT registration next quarter, we also need confirmation of how Redwood will route VAT evidence and whether you can split invoice lines by legal entity so our tax team can apply reverse-charge where applicable.

We recognize this is an operational ask. Can Redwood confirm whether you can: (a) accept the temporary remit moratorium for those invoices, (b) issue split-line invoices (by entity / VAT reg), and (c) accept a single PO (attached) referencing the moratorium?

I attached the PO to this message. I'm happy to jump on a quick call if useful.

Thanks,
Elaine Turner
Sr. Procurement Manager
BioVerge Therapeutics
attachments: BioVerge_PO_4589.pdf
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Turner <elaine.turner@bioverge.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 10:55:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary remit moratorium + tax entity routing

Elaine —

Appreciate the heads up and congrats on the acquisition. Quick summary from our side and a proposed path forward: 

1) Temporary moratorium: we can accommodate a 30-day payment deferral window for invoices generated between 2026-10-01 and 2026-10-31 provided we put a mutually agreed Amended Payment Addendum in place (covers collection schedule and credit guardrails).

2) Milestone payments: we can support the 40/40/20 split, but finance needs a signed PO + DocuSign addendum agreeing to the schedule. During the moratorium Redwood will mark those invoices as "Deferred - under moratorium" and set due dates per the milestone acceptance events.

3) Split-line invoicing / VAT routing: Kopied Kimberly for VAT/tax evidence flow. Kimberly — can Redwood produce invoices with separate legal-entity line items and include VAT registration numbers so BioVerge tax can apply reverse-charge? If there are format restrictions we can provide a template.

4) Credit / exposure: CCing Vanessa from CS/Billing to confirm this hits the BioVerge credit corridor. Vanessa — quick ask: can we keep total outstanding exposure capped at $350k during the moratorium (BioVerge's current committed spend) and require a 10% holdback until final acceptance? If that's not feasible, propose an alternate cap.

Next steps I propose:
- Vanessa/Kimberly review and confirm operational feasibility (24h).
- Elaine to return signed PO + executed DocuSign addendum (we can provide draft).
- Once PO + addendum are in, Redwood will generate the first deferred invoice and label it per the moratorium.

If you want to take this to a 20-minute call I'm available 11:30–12:30 PT today.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Elaine Turner <elaine.turner@bioverge.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 13:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary remit moratorium + tax entity routing

Thanks Marcus / Elaine — quick operational clearance from Billing: 

- We can implement a 30-day deferral for the Oct invoice window and flag invoices as "moratorium" in our AR system so collection cadence is paused.
- 40/40/20 milestone split works. We will require DocuSign addendum signed by an authorized BioVerge signer before the first deferred invoice posts.
- Credit cap: we can keep the exposure at $350k as proposed. We will enforce a 10% holdback per invoice until final acceptance.

Kimberly — can you confirm what evidence you need to support UK VAT routing? Elaine, if you can share the acquired entity's VAT registration and the intended billing entity, that will speed things.

I'll draft the addendum today and send as a DocuSign link. Jordan, looping you for visibility on the credit corridor — please advise if we should escalate for a temporary uplift.

Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Manager, Customer Billing Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Elaine Turner <elaine.turner@bioverge.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 15:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary remit moratorium + tax entity routing

Marcus / Vanessa / Kimberly —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the proposed approach. Attached is the signed PO and a spreadsheet with the UK entity VAT number and the proposed billing split (see Tax_Evidence_UK_entity.xlsx).

We reviewed the addendum and the DocuSign request looks good. A couple of minor asks: 
- Can Redwood include a line on each invoice that references the DocuSign addendum ID? It helps our AP queue.
- For the 10% holdback, BioVerge requests the holdback release trigger to be documented as "final acceptance sign-off" with a 10-business-day return window after sign-off for any warranty claims.

If those two points are OK we'll sign the DocuSign and proceed. Appreciate the flexibility here — this keeps our supply uninterrupted while we close the acquisition.

Best,
Elaine Turner
Sr. Procurement Manager
BioVerge Therapeutics
